text.id: Selamat pagi. Saya Ipda Yusuf, dari Polsek Penjaringan. Saya yang menangani laporan Mbak Sekar.
text.en: Good morning. I'm Inspector Yusuf, from the Penjaringan police station. I'm handling the report on Ms. Sekar.

text.id: Dan Anda?
text.en: And you are?

text.id: Raka. Temen Sekar. Dari Bandung.
text.en: Raka. Sekar's friend. From Bandung.

text.id: Teman. Hm.
text.en: A friend. Hm.

text.id: Ipda Yusuf duduk tanpa disuruh. Dia ngeluarin buku catatan kecil, tapi nggak nulis apa-apa. Matanya capek, tapi nggak galak.
text.en: Inspector Yusuf sits down without being asked. He takes out a small notebook, but doesn't write anything. His eyes are tired, but not unkind.

text.id: Saya mau jujur ke keluarga. Mbak Sekar sudah dewasa. Tidak ada tanda kekerasan, tidak ada tebusan, dompet ditinggal di rumah. Pola seperti ini biasanya orang yang pergi atas kemauan sendiri.
text.en: I'll be honest with the family. Ms. Sekar is an adult. No sign of violence, no ransom, wallet left at home. A pattern like this usually means someone who left of their own accord.

text.id: Dia nggak kabur, Pak. Saya udah bilang tiga kali.
text.en: She didn't run away, sir. I've told you three times.

text.id: Saya tahu, Dik. Tapi saya butuh sesuatu yang bisa saya tulis di laporan. Bukan perasaan.
text.en: I know, Dinda. But I need something I can put in a report. Not a feeling.

text.id: Mas Raka. Anda kenal dia lama. Apa yang bikin Anda yakin dia tidak pergi sendiri?
text.en: Mr. Raka. You've known her a long time. What makes you sure she didn't leave on her own?

text.id: Tunjukkan petunjuk yang membantah "kabur dari rumah".
text.en: Show a clue that contradicts "ran away from home".

text.id: Itu tidak membuktikan apa-apa soal dia pergi atau tidak. Ada yang lain?
text.en: That doesn't prove anything about whether she left. Anything else?

text.id: Perekamnya hilang. Baterai cadangan, kabel, headphone, semuanya. Orang yang kabur nggak bawa alat kerja, Pak. Dia pergi buat rekaman. Buat liputan.
text.en: Her recorder is gone. Spare batteries, cable, headphones, all of it. People running away don't take their work gear, sir. She went out to record. For a story.

text.id: ...Dompet ditinggal, tapi alat rekam dibawa.
text.en: ...Leaves her wallet, takes her recorder.

text.id: Itu masuk akal. Saya bisa minta rekaman CCTV di sekitar TPI Muara Angke dengan alasan itu. Tidak janji, tapi bisa saya coba.
text.en: That makes sense. I can request the CCTV footage around the Muara Angke fish auction on those grounds. No promises, but I can try.

text.id: Ada pesan buat saya. Ditulis sepuluh menit sebelum dia pergi. "Inget jam lima pagi itu? Gue masih di sana."
text.en: There's a message for me. Written ten minutes before she left. "Remember five in the morning? I'm still there."

text.id: Pesan untuk... teman lama. Yang sudah setahun tidak bicara, kalau saya tebak dari muka Anda.
text.en: A message to... an old friend. One she hasn't spoken to in a year, if I'm reading your face right.

text.id: Maaf, Mas. Tapi itu bisa dibaca dua arah. Bisa jadi minta tolong. Bisa jadi pamit.
text.en: I'm sorry. But that reads two ways. It could be a call for help. It could be a goodbye.

text.id: Ka. Itu bukan buat polisi.
text.en: Ka. That wasn't for the police.

text.id: Dia nandain jadwal kapal ke Pulau Pari. Jam setengah enam pagi.
text.en: She marked the ferry schedule to Pulau Pari. The five-thirty morning boat.

text.id: Kapal ke pulau. Pagi buta. Tanpa pamit ke keluarga.
text.en: A boat to an island. Before dawn. Without telling her family.

text.id: Mas, itu justru terdengar seperti orang yang merencanakan pergi.
text.en: That actually sounds like someone planning to leave.

text.id: Lo malah bikin dia makin yakin Kak Sekar kabur.
text.en: You just made him even more sure she ran away.

text.id: Saya mengerti. Perasaan keluarga itu penting. Tapi untuk sekarang, statusnya tetap orang hilang dewasa. Saya tinggalkan kartu nama saya.
text.en: I understand. How the family feels matters. But for now, the status stays an adult missing person. I'll leave you my card.

text.id: Satu lagi. Barang pribadi Mbak Sekar. Laptop, HP, buku catatan. Ada yang belum kami lihat?
text.en: One more thing. Ms. Sekar's personal things. Laptop, phones, notebooks. Anything we haven't seen?

text.id: HP cadangan itu lagi dicas di belakang sofa. Kabelnya kelihatan, kalau orang mau ngelihat.
text.en: The spare phone is charging behind the sofa. The cable is visible, if anyone cares to look.

text.id: Dinda ngelirik lo. Pelan, dia geleng.
text.en: Dinda glances at you. Slowly, she shakes her head.

text.id: "Nggak ada, Pak."
text.en: "No, sir. Nothing."

text.id: "Ada HP cadangan. Kami pegang dulu, nanti saya kabari."
text.en: "There's a spare phone. We'll hold on to it for now, I'll keep you posted."

text.id: (Diam.)
text.en: (Say nothing.)

text.id: Baik.{w} Kalau ada yang Anda ingat nanti, telepon saya. Kebohongan kecil di awal biasanya jadi masalah besar di akhir.
text.en: Very well.{w} If you remember anything later, call me. Small lies at the start usually become big problems at the end.

text.id: Terima kasih sudah jujur. Silakan dipegang. Kalau ada yang penting, kirim salinannya ke saya. Jangan bertindak sendiri.
text.en: Thank you for being honest. Keep it for now. If you find anything important, send me a copy. Don't act on your own.

text.id: Diam juga jawaban, Mas.{w} Saya permisi.
text.en: Silence is an answer too.{w} I'll see myself out.

text.id: Makasih. Gue nggak percaya polisi. Mereka udah mutusin dia kabur sebelum nyari.
text.en: Thanks. I don't trust the police. They decided she ran away before they even looked.

text.id: Lo ngasih tahu dia. Kenapa?
text.en: You told him. Why?

text.id: Karena kalau kita nemu sesuatu yang gede, kita butuh orang yang bisa ngapa-ngapain. Gue cuma tukang edit audio, Din.
text.en: Because if we find something big, we'll need someone who can actually do something. I just edit audio, Din.

text.id: ...Gue laper. Lo laper? Dari pagi gue cuma minum teh.
text.en: ...I'm hungry. Are you hungry? I've only had tea since this morning.
